name: Aegis DFM
mechanic: Oracle-driven base + surge fee, with fees reinvested into full-range liquidity.
plain: A dynamic-fee market maker that uses a truncated geometric oracle to set base and surge fees, takes a protocol share of each swap, and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position.
rules: Base and surge fees are set from a truncated geometric oracle.
Collected protocol fees reinvest into full-range liquidity.
